shared_state_rule: One resolved injury/availability state is consumed by player weekly projections, teammate redistribution, team offense, game projections, props and explanations. The same injury may not be applied twice through both direct-player and team-environment adjustments without an explicit decomposition.

polling.rule: Poll current injury/practice/designation state on every hourly scheduled orchestration invocation. A material injury-state change overrides the normal cadence skip and forces the football context -> weekly projection -> distribution -> downstream outlook pipeline to rerun before game lock.

IR.rule: Requires verified reserve/injured roster status. No playing-time projection is generated; fantasy UI may display 0 projected points with IR status because the player cannot play that week.

O.rule: Verified out/unavailable status forces no playing-time projection and a 0-point weekly display for the affected game.

D.rule: Doubtful forces REVIEW_REQUIRED and heightened availability uncertainty. It may reduce expected points only through a historically validated play-probability/workload model; no guessed fixed haircut is allowed.

Q.rule: Questionable/current workload uncertainty triggers a rerun. Mean/workload changes require current practice/workload evidence plus validated translation; uncertainty may be widened only by an authorized calibrated rule. No fixed Q haircut is allowed.

CLEARED.rule: Verified active/full-practice clearance removes stale Q/D/O status and triggers a rerun restoring the current healthy-state projection subject to other football evidence.

projection_decomposition.conditional_if_active_projection: Existing weekly football projection conditional on playing.
projection_decomposition.play_probability: Separate availability probability learned from historical designation + practice participation + injury context. O/IR are deterministic zero; Q/D coefficients require leakage-safe calibration before promotion.
projection_decomposition.workload_factor_if_active: Separate workload/ramp factor learned from historical practice/return evidence. Missing factor is unknown, never assumed to be 1 or 0.
projection_decomposition.current_authority: O/IR deterministic inactivity is authorized. Q/D play-probability and workload coefficients remain zero-authority until historical walk-forward calibration.

automatic_change_triggers: material workload restriction or return-to-full-work evidence changes
rerun_path: resolve latest designation and practice state
invalidate stale pregame weekly outlook for affected player/team
freeze_rule: Pregame outlooks may refresh whenever new verified evidence arrives. Once the relevant game starts, the frozen forecast used for calibration is immutable and must never be rewritten with hindsight.
promotion_requirements: Historical designation/practice participation outcomes are backfilled without hindsight leakage.
Q and D play-probability/workload mappings improve out-of-sample calibration versus no adjustment.
No double counting between direct injury availability and team-environment effects.
Automatic change detection is tested for injury, recovery and clearance transitions.
O/IR deterministic no-play behavior is tested separately from Q/D probabilistic behavior.
Full Guardrail QA passes on the exact promotion head.
